Data basis

Official CLI snapshot r100 · sha256:cc56e9dda8863810e0df39effcfa8f22837e8a59721e891207a323df409ea614 · generated 2026-01-15 00:00 UTC. The page depends only on this snapshot and the display configuration; no ledger or state database was read.

Definitions

  • “Stalled”: status in_progress and no event for ≥7 days.
  • Lanes come from the display configuration; the lane dependency graph groups by milestone.
  • Expired claims do not count as active claims.

Fields the official interfaces do not provide

  • node.goal: work graph and nav nodes carry no goal; membership exists only per goal (nav --goal), which this map does not query
  • node.scope: the contract or scope id is not exposed per item
  • node.priority: only work show returns it, one refreshing call per item; not collected in bulk
  • node.milestone: there is no bulk field; it is resolved only for the milestones named in the display configuration, through nav --milestone
  • project.scenarios: project-specific acceptance scenarios are outside the AWR work model and have no data source
  • project.release_funnel: a presentation concept without a data source
